EPOCHS = 10  # capped at 10

            nn.Sigmoid()
        )
        self.proj = nn.Conv1d(out_ch, out_ch, kernel_size=1)

    def forward(self, x):
        attn = self.attn(x)
        attn = attn.squeeze(1)
        attn = attn.unsqueeze(1)
